description:
MERN Full Stack Developer – Custom D2C E-commerce Platform
Mumbai | Full-time | 3–5 years

About Alpha Male
Alpha Male is one of India's first premium, science-backed men's wellness brands. We sell direct-to-consumer, and our brand is built on trust, discretion, education and a premium experience. We're a young, fast-growing team based in Mumbai.

About the Role
We're building our own custom D2C e-commerce platform from scratch. You will design the architecture, build, launch and maintain the complete platform: website, order flow, payments, shipping, admin panel, CRM, automations and reporting. You will be the technical owner of our D2C stack and work directly with leadership.

Tech Stack
MongoDB, Express.js, React / Next.js, Node.js (MongoDB Atlas, AWS / Vercel, GitHub)

WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Planning & Architecture
• Understand business requirements and convert them into a technical plan and timeline
• Design the system architecture, database schema and API structure
• Work with the UI/UX designer and build from approved Figma designs
• Set up the GitHub repository, coding standards, and staging and production environments

2. Storefront (Customer Website)
• Build a fast, SEO-friendly, mobile-first website using Next.js (SSR / SSG)
• Home, collection and product pages, combos and bundles, search, blog / education pages, FAQs, about and policy pages
• SEO setup: meta tags, sitemap, schema markup, clean URLs and page speed (Core Web Vitals)
• Customer reviews and ratings, trust badges and offer banners

3. Cart, Checkout & Customer Accounts
• Cart, coupons and discounts, OTP-based login and saved addresses
• Pincode serviceability check, prepaid and COD options, order summary
• Customer account: profile, order history, order tracking, reorder, returns and refunds

4. Payment Gateway Integration
• Integrate Razorpay / Cashfree (UPI, cards, net banking, wallets)
• Server-side payment verification through webhooks and signature checks (never trusting the browser alone)
• Failed-payment handling and retry, refunds through the gateway API
• Daily payment-to-order reconciliation so every successful payment creates an order

5. Orders, Invoicing & Inventory
• Complete order lifecycle: placed, confirmed, packed, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned
• GST-compliant invoice generation (PDF)
• Real-time inventory updates, with no overselling of the last unit

6. Shipping & Logistics Integration
• Integrate Shiprocket (or similar): order push, AWB generation, label printing
• Live order tracking for customers, delivery status updates, NDR handling
• COD remittance tracking

7. Admin Panel
• Secure admin with role-based access (admin, operations, marketing, support)
• Manage products, variants, prices, inventory, orders, customers, coupons, banners and returns
• Bulk actions, order exports and activity logs

8. CRM
• Customer profiles with full purchase history
• Tags, segments, lifetime value and repeat-purchase tracking
• Customer data available for marketing and retention campaigns

9. Automations (WhatsApp, SMS & Email)
• Order confirmation, shipping, delivery and refund updates
• Abandoned-cart recovery, reorder reminders, review requests and COD-to-prepaid nudges
• Integrate WhatsApp Business API, MSG91 (SMS / OTP) and an email service (AWS SES / Resend)

10. Tracking, Analytics & Reports
• Set up GA4, Meta Pixel + Conversions API and Google Ads conversion tracking
• Product feed for Google Merchant Center and Meta catalogue
• Reports dashboard: sales, orders, AOV, repeat rate, SKU performance, COD vs prepaid

11. Hosting, Security & Performance
• Deploy and manage hosting on AWS / Vercel / Render with SSL, domain and CDN
• Secure authentication, input validation, rate limiting and secure handling of secrets
• No card data stored, with customer data protected in line with India's DPDP Act
• Automated database backups, error monitoring (Sentry) and uptime monitoring
• Keep the site fast and stable during sales and high-traffic periods

12. Day-to-Day Maintenance
• Daily: check errors and uptime, reconcile payments with orders, fix urgent issues
• Weekly: bug fixes, content and product updates, backup checks, speed review
• Monthly: security and package updates, performance report, new features as planned
• Test every change on staging before it goes live

13. Documentation & Ownership
• Maintain clear documentation: README, API docs, architecture and setup guides
• Keep all code, servers and accounts in the company's name
• Write clean, maintainable code so the platform can scale and be handed over easily

14. Collaboration
• Work with leadership on priorities and timelines, with regular progress updates
• Work with the performance marketing team on tracking, landing pages and offers
• Work with operations and customer support on order, shipping and return issues

REQUIREMENTS
• 3–5 years of hands-on experience with MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js
• Has built and launched at least one live e-commerce or payment-enabled web application
• Experience integrating payment gateways (Razorpay / Cashfree / PayU) with webhooks
• Strong experience with Next.js for SEO-friendly, high-performance websites
• Experience integrating third-party APIs (shipping, SMS, WhatsApp, email)
• Experience deploying and maintaining production apps on AWS, Vercel or Render
• Good understanding of security, performance and database design
• Clean, documented code and a strong sense of ownership

GOOD TO HAVE
• TypeScript, Redis, Docker and CI/CD
• WhatsApp Business API, Shiprocket or Shopify API experience
• Experience at a D2C or e-commerce startup

WHAT WE OFFER
• Competitive CTC
• Build a complete D2C platform from scratch and own its architecture
• Direct work with leadership, with fast decisions
• A fast-growing brand with room to grow into a tech lead role

HOW TO APPLY
Apply through LinkedIn, or email your CV with your GitHub profile and live project links to info@alphamale.co.in with the subject line Application – MERN Full Stack Developer

description:
Job Description

About the Engineering Team

Chegg’s engineering team is a community of passionate builders who partner closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to shape the future of online learning. Grounded in Chegg’s core values— putting students first, acting with integrity, and holding a high bar for excellence —we build with care and accountability. As the world and our industry continue to evolve , we stay true to those principles: we invest in quality, design for scale and longevity, and avoid shortcuts (hello unit tests and documentation) so we can deliver reliable, high-impact experiences on time.

About The Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer II, Frontend to own the design, quality, and delivery of features across our student-facing web applications. This role is focused on building React/Next.js product experiences, the GraphQL-powered data layers behind them, and increasingly, AI-powered study features (step-by-step solutions, Q&A, and personalized study assistance). You will also contribute across the stack as needed — this is a frontend-first role with full-stack reach, and you should be comfortable enough with backend concepts and AWS infrastructure to ramp into our Java or Python backend services when a task calls for it.

What You'll Do

Own frontend features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, testing, staged rollout, and production monitoring — across student-facing web application.
Translate product requirements into component architecture, GraphQL query/schema boundaries, and client-state contracts (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar) that other engineers build on.
Debug cross-system issues that surface in the UI — GraphQL supergraph errors, auth/session edge cases, server/client rendering mismatches — by tracing root cause across the stack.
Build AI-powered study features responsibly: validate model output (e.g., step-by-step solutions, Q&A answers) before it reaches the UI, design graceful fallbacks for unusable or low-confidence responses, and instrument these flows with telemetry.
Apply security and data-protection practices — input validation, secure auth/session handling, careful treatment of student data — as a default part of the code you ship, not a step someone else checks for.
Optimize application performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals) as an ongoing part of feature work, particularly for high-traffic student study flows.
Own the quality of your changes through automated tests (unit, component, and end-to-end), CI stability, and production validation.
Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend to deliver and harden high-impact student workflows (search, Q&A, subscription/paywall flows, study tools).
Contribute to engineering quality through strong code reviews — including review of AI-generated code — reusable patterns, shared components, and clear documentation that keeps technical debt low.
Ship end-to-end changes across the web application and its supporting APIs/schema, as needed.

Required Qualifications

Most qualified candidates will likely bring 4+ years of professional frontend engineering experience building production web applications, with demonstrated ownership of features from design through launch.
Strong hands-on experience with React and Next.js, and comfort working in TypeScript.
Working knowledge of web fundamentals — common security pitfalls (XSS, CSRF, auth/session handling), performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals), and accessibility (WCAG/ARIA basics) — and the judgment to apply them without being told to.
Experience designing and consuming APIs across common paradigms — GraphQL (schema design, codegen, querying), REST, and real-time protocols such as WebSockets — and working with at least one modern client-state approach (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar).
Strong testing and release-validation discipline — unit/component testing (Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library) and end-to-end testing (Playwright or Cypress).
Comfort using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, validate, and safely ship the code you produce.
Sound understanding of data structures, algorithms, and general software design principles, applied pragmatically rather than academically.

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking, basic service architecture) and some Node.js backend exposure — enough of a foundation to ramp into our Java or Python backend services when needed.
Experience with Auth0 or similar authentication providers in a Next.js application.
Experience shipping AI-powered UI — streaming responses, structured output rendering, graceful handling of model failures. Experience contributing to shared component libraries or tooling used across multiple teams/repos.
Familiarity with frontend observability tooling (New Relic or similar).
Experience in EdTech, e-commerce, or another high-traffic, subscription-based consumer product company.

Tech Stack

Frontend: React (18/19), Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL (Apollo tooling, codegen against a shared supergraph), React Query / Redux Toolkit / Zustand, styled-components, MUI
Backend (foundational): Node.js, AWS (compute/storage/networking basics) — enough to ramp into Kotlin/Java (Spring) or Python (FastAPI/Django) services owned by backend engineering
Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright
Auth / Delivery: Auth0, GitLab CI
Observability: New Relic
AI / ML: OpenAI, RAG, MCP, AWS Bedrock (via shared backend integrations)

Why do we exist?

Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future.
